question: Mango shower is a term used for _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**pre-monsoon showers**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mango showers** are pre-monsoon showers that occur in India and some other parts of Southeast Asia.
 
• These showers usually occur from March to April and are important for the mango crop, hence the name.
 
• Mango showe
